photo.source: airport-data.com photo 000820598, Todd Royer, KOSH 2012-07-25, left side in flight, 1920 px wide; reference only, not redistributed
photo.fit: least-squares similarity; 0.00567 m/px, 0.9 deg rotation, residuals 0.004, 0.063, 0.059 m

stripes.name: SwooshRed

stripes.name: SwooshNavy

stripes.name: FinSwooshRed

stripes.name: FinSwooshNavy
stripes.what: navy crescent of the fin swoosh

measured_px.method: navy pixels (B < 120, R+G+B < 300) in the box, deslanted by the shear that best separates glyphs

registration.regulation: 14 CFR 45.29 (current text via LII, fetched 2026-11-09): fixed-wing marks at least 12 in high (b); width 2/3 of height (c); stroke 1/6 of height (d); spacing at least 1/4 of width (e); same on both sides (g)
registration.confidence: medium: the photo gives 12.4-13.1 in tall and 0.61 H wide, within blur and perspective of 12 in x 8 in; the regulation proportions are used

glyphs.units: cap height; x right from the glyph's left edge (0 to 1 = glyph width), y up from the baseline; stroke centrelines, filleted at interior corners by radius (cap height units)
glyphs.style: project-drawn square italic capitals traced to the photo; not derived from any font
